description: Create a new Security Case Evidence. Returns it with its ID. projectId comes from your credentials. Field details: oneuptime_describe_resource.

kind.description: What the evidence is: a File uploaded to OneUptime, a Link to evidence kept somewhere else, or an Event bookmarked from Security Events. It can't be changed.

name.description: What the evidence is, in a few words. A file's own name when none is given.

securityCaseId.description: ID of the case this evidence is kept on.

name: create_security_case_evidence
